Hi everyone! I'm happy to announce a new release, two months after the previous one. 

Before I get to the changelog, some special notes:

- From this release onwards, the old list of supported apps is replaced by the new, crowdsourced [touchHLE app compatibility database](https://appdb.touchhle.org/).
- In case you missed it, the [touchHLE app archive](https://touchhle.org/app-archive/) was recently launched. It only has one app at the moment, but that's hopefully just the start. If you were an indie developer in the early iPhone days, please get in touch!
- If you want to get notified about future releases, you might want to join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sVMXc8z3eS). You can't post there, but you'll be @'d with updates. There's also a [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@touchHLE) where I post short gameplay videos with new releases.
- If you want to help me keep working on this full time, please consider [supporting me financially](https://liberapay.com/hikari_no_yume).

Finally, a big thanks to all the other contributors who made this release what it was! If it weren't for them, there might not have been any new game support in this release.

Happy Hallowee

releases.body:
2026.10.01:
  - Fixed DOS FCB operations trying to read/write from device_CON when performed
    on an unopened or non-existent file. (cimarronm)
  - Don't prompt for working directory when -conf or -userconf is used
    (maron2000)
  - Added RPC debugger agent interface (freeng)
  - Fix OpenGL scaling when modeswitch is off (jpernst)
  - Modesetting resolution change exclusive to fullscreen. (DieSkarrj)
  - Added MCP Protocol support (caiiiycuk)
  - Fixed parsing of command-line executable arguments (maron2000)
  - Enable PS2 mouse events (cyberfox)
  - Fixed VHD fixed-disk geometry detection to correctly decode the partition
    start cylinder from the MBR CHS fields (the high bits were not shifted),
    reject malformed CHS/LBA partition entries instead of producing a bad or
    out-of-bounds sector address. (cimarronm)
  - Added /V arg for `VER` command to just report the version (bushtail)
  - drive_virtual: fixed CHDIR succeeding on a file on drive Z:
    (MaxFreedomPollard)

releases.body: # ARMSX2 2.9.2 What's new: **Report a problem.** Found in the library menu, the side drawer and every game's pause menu. Pick what went wrong, add a few words if you like, and see every file and its size before anything is sent. releases.name: v2.5.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Disk images are kept unmodified with a save directory.** With `-saveDir`, what the software writes goes to an overlay file there and the image is only read. Overlays store only the tracks or blocks written and are tied to a checksum of their image. This also makes writable the disks that could not be written before: inside a zip or gzip, loaded from a URL, or embedded in the executable.
- **DOS 3.3 boots in five seconds.** The Disk II motor keeps turning for about a second after the drive is turned off, like the 556 timer of the real controller, and the data latch no longer reads the same nibble twice. DOS no longer waits for the motor on every access: a DOS 3.3 boot takes 5.4 million cycles instead of 36 million.

### How

Copy your dump (or `.nup`) to the phone, open **Anka Native**, tap **Add game**, pick the dump and tap **Prepare**. The app does three things in the background, with a notification:

1. It rewrites the game's code.
2. It scans the game's files for shaders.
3. It translates the shaders.

When it is done, the game's card says Ready.

- If a step fails, the card says why. Its log is in `<title ID>-work/ondevice/logs` next to the dump. Preparing on a computer still works as before.
